--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions.go
@@ -0,0 +1,83 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"strconv"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	auth "go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+var authMethods = map[string]auth.Method{
+	"token":      auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
+	"oidc":       auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC,
+	"kubernetes": auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"k8s":        auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"github":     auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB,
+	"jwt":        auth.Method_METHOD_JWT,
+	"cloud":      auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD,
+}
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(
+		&rego.Function{
+			Name: "flipt.is_auth_method",
+			Decl: types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.A, types.S), types.B),
+		},
+		isAuthMethod,
+	)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	inputObject, ok := input.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, errors.New("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	authentication := inputObject.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, errors.New("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	authenticationObject, ok := authentication.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, errors.New("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	methodKey, ok := key.Value.(ast.String)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %v", key.Value)
+	}
+
+	expectedMethod, ok := authMethods[string(methodKey)]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", string(methodKey))
+	}
+
+	method := authenticationObject.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	if method == nil {
+		return ast.BooleanTerm(false), nil
+	}
+
+	actualMethod, ok := authMethodFromTerm(method)
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(ok && actualMethod == expectedMethod), nil
+}
+
+func authMethodFromTerm(term *ast.Term) (auth.Method, bool) {
+	switch value := term.Value.(type) {
+	case ast.Number:
+		code, err := strconv.ParseInt(string(value), 10, 32)
+		if err != nil {
+			return auth.Method_METHOD_NONE, false
+		}
+		return auth.Method(code), true
+	case ast.String:
+		code, ok := auth.Method_value[string(value)]
+		return auth.Method(code), ok
+	default:
+		return auth.Method_METHOD_NONE, false
+	}
+}
diff --git a/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go b/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go

@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		method string
+		code   int
+	}{
+		{name: "token", method: "token", code: 1},
+		{name: "oidc", method: "oidc", code: 2},
+		{name: "kubernetes", method: "kubernetes", code: 3},
+		{name: "k8s alias", method: "k8s", code: 3},
+		{name: "github", method: "github", code: 4},
+		{name: "jwt", method: "jwt", code: 5},
+		{name: "cloud", method: "cloud", code: 6},
+	}
+
+	for _, test := range tests {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			matched, err := evaluateAuthMethod(t, test.code, test.method)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.True(t, matched)
+
+			unmatched, err := evaluateAuthMethod(t, 0, test.method)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.False(t, unmatched)
+		})
+	}
+
+	t.Run("protobuf enum string input", func(t *testing.T) {
+		matched, err := evaluateAuthMethod(t, "METHOD_JWT", "jwt")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.True(t, matched)
+	})
+}
+
+func TestIsAuthMethodErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	_, err := isAuthMethod(
+		rego.BuiltinContext{},
+		parseTerm(t, `{}`),
+		parseTerm(t, `"jwt"`),
+	)
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")
+
+	_, err = isAuthMethod(
+		rego.BuiltinContext{},
+		parseTerm(t, `{"authentication":{"method":5}}`),
+		parseTerm(t, `"saml"`),
+	)
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "unsupported auth method: saml")
+}
+
+func evaluateAuthMethod(t *testing.T, actual any, expected string) (bool, error) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	input := map[string]any{
+		"authentication": map[string]any{"method": actual},
+	}
+
+	query, err := rego.New(
+		rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "`+expected+`")`),
+		rego.Input(input),
+	).PrepareForEval(context.Background())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	results, err := query.Eval(context.Background())
+	if err != nil {
+		return false, err
+	}
+	require.Len(t, results, 1)
+	matched, ok := results[0].Expressions[0].Value.(bool)
+	require.True(t, ok)
+	return matched, nil
+}
+
+func parseTerm(t *testing.T, input string) *ast.Term {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	term, err := ast.ParseTerm(input)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return term
+}
